source: Ingested r/LegalAdviceUK hot posts in web/data/reddit-trending.json. Live RSS returned HTTP 429 on this run, so these were not taken from a fresh feed.
note: Local queue only. Approve in /dev/blog-review. Do not publish Reddit links.

drafts.title: Faulty used car in the first week: who helps?
drafts.why: Dealer used car faults inside a week. Distinct from garage repair after the fact and from goods outside warranty.

drafts.title: Energy supplier took the wrong direct debit: who helps?
drafts.why: Wrong amount and frequency on an energy Direct Debit. Existing pages cover price rises and the ombudsman generally, not this payment error.

drafts.title: Contractor damaged my parked car: who helps?
drafts.why: Named contractor denies damage. Distinct from an unidentified driver leaving the scene.

drafts.title: Venue refused my medical bag: who helps?
drafts.why: Service provider reasonable adjustments. Existing discrimination pages are about work, not a venue gate.

drafts.title: Souvenir tickets arrived late and damaged: who helps?
drafts.why: Damaged paid for souvenir goods in Scotland. Distinct from train tickets and flight disruption.

drafts.title: Private parking charge for a car I never owned: who helps?
drafts.why: Wrong keeper, vehicle never owned. Sibling of the wrong registration page, which is your own car.

drafts.title: Landlord charging for time and worn carpets: who helps?
drafts.why: Unfair end of tenancy deductions. Links the existing deposit explainers instead of copying them.

drafts.title: Missed connection after a flight delay: who helps?
drafts.why: Delay and a missed connection on one ticket. Sibling of the oversold flight page.

drafts.title: Debt collector text about an ex partner’s contract: who helps?
drafts.why: Chase for someone else’s phone contract. Distinct from family spend on your own credit card.

drafts.title: Ex will not return my belongings: who helps?
drafts.why: Specific goods not handed back. Links the separation belongings page instead of rewriting the financial split.
